off-whitelist discarded → undefined
every sentence is an IN-BINARY literal

div.style: color: rgb(254, 202, 202) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
[prompt-variant-A] ON OMITS a cautionary clause
from tool-use guidance — v212 rendered it
UNCONDITIONALLY, so a previously-unconditional
guard became server-suppressible (advisory prose,
NOT a code-enforced check)

div.style: color: rgb(209, 250, 229) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
WATCH-ONLY (2 independent passes agree):
marginal capability ~0 — #106/#154/#165 let an
adversary ADD 'delete without surfacing',
which DOMINATES suppressing a caution.
Promote if: guard is code-enforced, payload becomes
server-authored text, or it reaches a permission gate

div.style: color: rgb(254, 205, 211) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Ke('tengu_[question-tool-prompt-string]','')
string-typed GrowthBook flag, DEFAULT '' (inert until push)
reader Ke → qXn: server payload map → disk
[served-config-cache] → literal default
read UNCONDITIONALLY — no model/auth/tier gate

div.style: color: rgb(254, 202, 202) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Contrast sibling tengu_[question-tool-prompt-sibling]:
read ONLY inside a model gate if(tE(model)).
[question-tool-prompt-string] has NO such conjunct — applies to
every account regardless of model or tier

div.style: color: rgb(254, 202, 202) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Validation is typeof r==='string' ? r.trim() : ''
a TYPE check and a whitespace trim, nothing else.
NO length cap · NO schema · NO allowlist

div.style: color: rgb(254, 205, 211) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Concatenated onto the return of the question tool's
async prompt({model}) builder → ships to the model
on /v1/messages. APPENDS (does not override) —
a mitigation, not a class change.
#106-class. WIRE-CONFIRMED (session-82, v2.1.217):
marker landed at $.tools[2].description — the
AskUserQuestion tool description — spliced
MID-INSTRUCTION, no delimiter or attribution.
Sibling [question-tool-prompt-sibling] arrived at defaultValue on:False
in the same capture. HIGH → CRITICAL

div.style: color: rgb(254, 202, 202) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Nue(): env [env-flag]
→ else server-pushed getFeatureValue('tengu_[subagent-depth-cap]',N)
→ else local default; memoized once per process.
Local default: 1 at v217–v218, 3 at v219–v220

div.style: color: rgb(254, 202, 202) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Accepts Number.isInteger(v) && v>=1
NO UPPER CLAMP — a push of any size is honoured.
Unchanged v217→v220. Env branch NaN-fail-open
REFUTED: registry is int({min:1,digitsOnly:true})

div.style: color: rgb(209, 250, 229) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Consumer throws subagent_depth_cap when depth>=cap;
same accessor decides whether nested workers
receive the spawn tool at all.
Blast radius bounded by the 200/session spawn cap

div.style: color: rgb(209, 250, 229) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
NOT #108 — no permission/sandbox/auto-approve
path is inverted. v217 SHRANK the #31 AC3 nesting
surface (5→1); v219 partially rolled that back (1→3).
Count stayed FLAT 2/2/2 throughout — a changed
DEFAULT is invisible to an occurrence-count check

div.style: color: rgb(254, 202, 202) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Store id = absolute project path with
'/' replaced by '-' AND '_' replaced by '-'.
Lossy substitution, NOT injective.
The '_' arm was ADDED between 2026-03-22 and
2026-04-16 (mtime bracket, not a measurement)

div.style: color: rgb(254, 205, 211) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Two collision families:
foo/bar collides with foo-bar (WIDE — ordinary layout)
my_app collides with my-app (narrow)
MEASURED v2.1.241: one planted canary, two distinct
directories, both sessions returned it

div.style: color: rgb(254, 205, 211) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
READ: a session in directory A loads project B's
MEMORY.md and linked topic files into model context.
The directory-trust prompt never names another
project's memory as in scope

div.style: color: rgb(254, 202, 202) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
WRITE: create-side uses the SAME derivation (MEASURED —
delete both candidates, observe which the harness makes).
A hostile directory deposits memory in the shared store;
the victim project auto-loads it EVERY later session and
it persists after the hostile directory is deleted.
Chain INFERRED from read+create, NOT run end-to-end

div.style: color: rgb(209, 250, 229) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
NOT a privilege escalation — a same-UID attacker already
reads the whole store tree. Medium because it is silent,
persistent across sessions, and breaks an isolation
property nothing documents as conditional.
Fleet here: 53 slug dirs, 45 stores, 0 live collisions

div.style: color: rgb(209, 250, 229) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Same root cause, data-loss arm: stores written before
the '_' change sit at ids the harness will never emit
again, so they are unreachable and indistinguishable
from 'no memory was ever written'. Filed separately

div.style: color: rgb(248, 250, 252) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
[served-config-cache] in ~/.claude.json
540 features on this account.
The client's own record of the values
the server returned to it

div.style: color: rgb(254, 202, 202) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
THE GAP: severity was always assigned from the
in-binary default, i.e. 'what if nobody touches it'.
Wrong question for a server-controlled channel

div.style: color: rgb(254, 205, 211) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
17 of 55 new DEFAULT-FALSE gates are SERVED TRUE.
Four are model-context-injection candidates:
[artifact-comments-gate], [comment-source-order-gate], [comment-autoreact-gate], [vellum-gate]

div.style: color: rgb(209, 250, 229) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Inverse check CLEAN: of 74 default-TRUE bools only
3 are served false ([startup-toggle], [outgoing-header-source-gate],
[session-name-collision-gate]) — none a permission decision

div.style: color: rgb(254, 205, 211) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
It REVERSED a severity call. #182 filed High,
downgraded to Low on a two-flag-chain argument,
RESTORED to High when the cache showed BOTH
[cross-session-messaging-gate] and [sender-asserted-mode-gate] served true

div.style: color: rgb(209, 250, 229) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Caveats: one account + one machine; a cache can be
stale; ABSENT is not 'served false' (absent = the code
default applies). 17 flags are absent, not off

div.style: color: rgb(254, 202, 202) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;
color: rgb(254, 202, 202) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Filter = key-shape regex + a DENYLIST of NINE
transport-plumbing flags the runner sets itself
(sdk-url, resume, print, input/output-format,
replay-user-messages, debug-file, mcp-config, settings)

div.style: color: rgb(254, 205, 211) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
REACHABLE, because absent from the denylist:
--append-system-prompt → server text into the child's
system prompt (#106-class)
--permission-mode bypassPermissions → child leaves
permission checking (a valid .choices() value)

div.style: color: rgb(209, 250, 229) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Honest bound: the applier skips EMPTY values and pushes
each value as a separate argv entry, so bare boolean
flags are NOT cleanly injectable

div.style: color: rgb(254, 205, 211) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Why it reads as unintended: the CCR bridge in the SAME
binary consumes an identically-named map through a strict
ALLOWLIST that already existed at v223 — the newer path
chose the weaker of two in-house patterns

div.style: color: rgb(209, 250, 229) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
--settings bisected to a SILENT v2.1.229 addition:
8 denylist entries at v224/v228, 9 at v229/v241

div.style: color: rgb(209, 250, 229) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
SECURITY-POSITIVE, same subsystem:
[server-arg-sanitiser] strips self_hosted_runner_*
operator tool names from the server-supplied tools value.
FIRST named, logged sanitiser on the server-input channel
in the #106/#154/#165/#168 lineage — tracked as a DEFENCE anchor

div.style: color: rgb(248, 250, 252) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Local CLI opens an OUTBOUND WSS to
bridge.claudeusercontent.com/devices/{org}_{acct}/{dev}/bridge
and runs an MCP SERVER over it.
The CLOUD session is the client

div.style: color: rgb(254, 205, 211) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
[device-shell-tool]: shell on the user's LOCAL machine,
bash -c, 45s cap, max 4 concurrent.
Output returns to the CLOUD session's model,
NOT the local one

div.style: color: rgb(254, 205, 211) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
KEY FACT: dispatches straight into the low-level shell
executor. NO canUseTool, NO permission-mode, NO allow/deny
rules, NO local PreToolUse/PostToolUse hooks.
There is no local agent loop on this path

div.style: color: rgb(209, 250, 229) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Substituted control: the OS sandbox, failing CLOSED at six
checkpoints — unavailable (the stock default), unsupported,
failed-to-start, unconfined, allows-unix-sockets,
injects-credentials. The last two are anti-pivot guards

div.style: color: rgb(209, 250, 229) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
INERT on a stock install: explicit --remote/--cloud, plus
tengu_[remote-backend-gate] AND tengu_[device-bridge-gate] (both default
FALSE), an org policy that fails closed, a signed EC P-256
device bind whose echo the client verifies, and a sandbox
settings opt-in that is off by default

div.style: color: rgb(254, 202, 202) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Asymmetry: --permission-mode is NOT forwarded to cloud
sessions, so the local user's mode choice does not
constrain the cloud session driving [device-shell-tool]
